scientific_integrity: Proof given by exact Venn atom enumeration and an all-parameter four-set obstruction; direct finite checks are supplementary. A counterexample or older equivalent enumeration would invalidate affected assertions.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the Kneser diagonal n=3r-3 and integers r>=11; earlier scalar maximum 2-packing number is credited. Published coding-theory classifications of smaller parameters do not imply the claimed full infinite-range enumerator. Absolute historical priority and independent auditing are not asserted.
title: The complete \(2\)-packing polynomial and eight optimal orbits of \(K(3r-3,r)\)
